title: Laser Therapy to Treat the Dry Mouth of Sjogren's Syndrome
brief_summary: This study was designed to test the efficacy and safety of low laser therapy to treat the xerostomia of patients with primary Sjogren's Syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with primary Sjogren Syndrome according criteria american european 2002.
* Salivary flux non stimulated \< 0,1 ml/min.

Exclusion Criteria:

* hepatitis B and/or C
* radiotherapy in the glandular area (previous)
* other connective diseases
* thyroidopathy non compensated
* GVHD graft-versus-host disease
* HIV
* Sarcoidosis
